project: Autonomous strap-housing installer for phone cases

coordinate_conventions.case: X/Y are the case in its own axes; Z=0 is the exterior back face, +Z points into the phone cavity
coordinate_conventions.housing_rect: axis-aligned rectangle in case coordinates; x0/y0 is the near corner, x1/y1 the far corner
coordinate_conventions.housing_placement: the rectangle, not a centre; the centre is ((x0+x1)/2, (y0+y1)/2)
coordinate_conventions.strap_datum: X centred on the band, Y=0 at the fixed end, Z=0 the exterior back face

drives.bundled: human_kit/ - the pack's own copy of the four SCAD files, used by default so the pack runs standalone
drives.fallback: ../Human_Kit - used only if the bundled copy is absent
drives.note: The agent sets these files' parameters with -D overrides and carries no copy of the geometry itself. When a sibling Human Kit is present, the bundle is compared against it and a divergence is reported as a warning.

pipeline: repair: collapse non-manifold edges no longer than --repair-tolerance, abort above it
measure: exterior back face, panel thickness, visible outline
fit: shrink the outline until the cut ring stays inside back-panel material
cut: render the Human Kit cutter and subtract it
split: extract perimeter and backplate, check the volume budget, validate both parts
strap: generate the strap from the same parameter set as the housing
housing: place it clear of openings, offset from the centreline and clear of the interlock, then subtract it
verify: component count, watertightness, volume budgets, report.md and report.json

measurement_methods.back_face: larger flat surface area at a Z extreme
measurement_methods.panel_thickness: median first-wall thickness over nine ray casts
measurement_methods.visible_outline: footprint of vertices within 0.5 mm of the back face
measurement_methods.fitted_outline: shrink until worst wall on the cut ring <= backplate_thickness + cut_end_overrun
measurement_methods.openings: ray-parity scan of the back panel on a 0.6 mm grid, clustered; each bounding box is expanded by half a grid step because samples lie inside the hole
measurement_methods.placement: candidate search over the usable rectangle, scored on the tighter of opening clearance and interlock clearance

placement_rules.why_offset: The kickstand rests at two angles because the strap sits off the case centreline; centred, it stands at one. On a device with a camera cluster the offset also keeps the housing out of the openings.
placement_rules.no_openings: A back panel with no through-openings is valid (not every device has a camera behind the case). The placement then relies on the offset alone, and --camera-end decides which way up the phone goes; without it the camera end is assumed 'low' and recorded as assumed.

reference_case.title: S25 Ultra case with edge protection
reference_case.author: Alex (@alexm2901)
reference_case.note: Third-party model. Not the author's work. Included as a remix under the same licence, with attribution.

reference_run.repairs: 2 degenerate edges collapsed (0.007 mm, 0.017 mm), max displacement 0.0165 mm

strap_parameters.derived: ear centre spacing, track centre spacing, track width and strap window width all follow from the three values above, inside strap_system_parameters.scad
strap_parameters.assertions: the parameter file refuses to render when the ear/band overlap is under 0.4 mm, the track clearance is under 0.4 mm, or the window is narrower than the band

spring_gaps.note: Three different artefacts. Never copy one value into another without regenerating and inspecting the bridge path.

limitations: Through-openings are detected on the back panel only; side ports, buttons, raised camera islands and existing rails are not detected
Openings are approximated by expanded bounding rectangles, so clearances are conservative but the shapes are not modelled
Chamfer is a parameter (6.0 mm default), not measured
The main Python pipeline exports STL only; STEP export is a separate FreeCAD module (modules/build_agentsafe_housing.py) that builds the housing negative, not the case parts
A clean boolean is not a fit test
With no openings detected the camera end is assumed, not known
A case too narrow to offset the housing cannot give a two-angle stand
